paragraphs: Antigonus of Sokho, Avot, chapter 1, received from Shimon the righteous. He said, “Do not be like servants who serve in order to receive a reward.” Students Tzadok and Boethus erred, became leaders of sectarians, and used gold and silver vessels throughout life. See Avot de-Rabbi Natan’s entire account; Maimonides, Avot 1; Rashbam, Yesh Nochalin; what is written in Tzemach David, part I, 3460. He brought firstborn animals from Babylonia, and they did not accept them from him. Temurah 21a reads “Ben Antigonus.”; see Nittai of Tekoa. Elazar ben Charsom was high priest in his generation; see there. His pious students: Yosef ben Yo'ezer and Yosef ben Yochanan.
